exact_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Faithfully enhance only the ENTIRE existing original Silent Storm painted-game color texture. Image1 exact historicalfullRGBA, image2 identical full historicalstoredRGB enlarged solely nearest-neighbor for placement/count reference. Preserve fullretail orientation/UV/margins/contours, source count/phase/nativepatternscale/weakpigment/localpalette/lightstrength and deliberate softblur. Gently resolve only fine original paint continuity; do not addphysicaldetails/geometry/marks/hardware/reflections/glints/rims/photography or new texturegrain. GUIDEPIXELBLOCKS must not become hardstairs/materialcells; old smoothsoft painted contours stay soft even when guide is blocky. Originalfullalpha separatelyrestored/global scalar brightnessonly. No crop/BBox/padding/registration/recentering/repacking/rotation/sourceRGBrepair/comparisons. Return one complete texture. Entire original41x41 soft painted UI icon. Preserve exactly ONE original calm golden-yellow/orange circular field, ONE old darkbrown/nearblack surrounding annular paintband, and ONE connected original black interior glyph shape. Keep sourcecircle/annulus nativecenter(20,20), oldradius/unevenbandwidth/softedges/nativephase, subdued original yellow/orange hue with almost no blue; sourceRGB peaks253/190/33 or253/189/26, do NOT create white glints/metal/glass/embossedbutton/more saturated neonhalo/newradialrays/texturegrain/extra inner or outerrings. Gently resolve only existing finepaintcontinuity, originalmatte shadedpixelwash/lightstrength and oldasymmetries. Exact historical alpha is circular0..255 and willrestorewholeoriginalA at4x, but internalglyph is blackRGB in positiveA so alpha restoration DOES NOT repair the glyph: preserve exactsourceglyph geometry/phase in generatedRGB, no fontsubstitution/modernicon/typeface/roundedstandardshape/redrawing/recenter. All old positiveA-blackglyph/weakwarmedgepixels captured in exact nativeRGBA guide; retain them, no new innerhole/cornerdots/strokes/panels. GUIDEPIXELBLOCKS source samples only, not hardmosaic/decorativecells/bevels; originalsampledpaintblur retained. Full41x41 retailUV/blackmargins/alpha/scale, no crop/padding/rotation/repacking/registration/artRGBrepair. Original glyph points UP: ONE connected arrow-like blackshape with ONE old triangular upperhead and ONE attached oldshortshaft/lowerflatfield; no newarrowhead/notch/holes/strokes. Original darkcore row13 x18..22, row19 x13..27, row21/23 x18..22, row25 x17..23. Native row27 has darkedgecoresx17..18 and22..23 with oldweaker warmmiddlepixels; preserve that exact weakoldbasewash as vaguepigment, not a newhole/pedestal/letter. Oldhead shoulders/endpoints/sourceasymmetry/nativephase and lightfieldmustnotregularize to a modernuniformarrow/typeface. All1681 originalRGBA cells authoritative beforeproof, no inferred standardfont.
